about_the_game:
Glitch Party is a party game for 2-8 players online. Challenge your friends in different minigames, each with a small chance of being glitched. Welcome to Glitch Party!



Minigames
Comepete in varius diffrent minigames. Racing, fighting, strategic competitions, last to survive, and many others. Powered by Unreal Engine 5 you get beautiful maps, physics, and lighting.

Glitched Version
Each minigame has a small chance of spawning as a glitched version. With increased points, more action, and different twists, it spices things up.

Game Modes
Choose amount of minigames to compete in and the probability to get the glitched version.

Characters
Choose between 8 different characters each with their own voice.

Development
Glitch Party is made by Gyllensten Games, a solo developer game studio creating its first game.
